owner_authorization: Owner-approved static replacement design only. B8.9-M and B8.9A are forbidden under this gate; no activation, execution, data, return, validation, provider, broker, credential, paid, paper, or real-money action is authorized.

preregistration.role: accepted L-4 v4 science and decision contract

preserved_science.research_question: On matched pre-2016 U8-common weekly dates, does U8 versus U4 reduce dependency/concentration and increase independent trend opportunity after locked costs and deterministic robustness, without a profitability claim?

universes.dates: Exactly U8-common eligible weekly decision dates; no pairwise, complete-case, post-result, or validation selection.

primary_sizing.step_1: u[i,t] = q[i,t] with no division by volatility.
primary_sizing.sensitivity: One frozen q/volatility sensitivity is non-claim-eligible and cannot choose a conclusion.

static_capacity.observation_unit: one weekly paired portfolio observation; never assets, sleeves, correlations, days, trades, or overlapping realized windows.

inherited_controls.primary_sizing: Primary u[i,t]=q[i,t], then inherited L1 normalization, 60-session EWMA PSD-clipped covariance target-volatility scale-down-only, caps, cash, weekly timing, trade threshold, locked costs, and accounting identically to U4/U8.
inherited_controls.matched_dates: Exactly U8-common eligible weekly decision dates; no pairwise, complete-case, post-result, or validation selection.
inherited_controls.l3_status: L-3 remains unresolved; the frozen q/volatility sensitivity is non-claim-eligible and cannot select a conclusion.

component_risk.formula: rc_i = w_i * (Sigma w)_i; p_i = abs(rc_i) / sum_j abs(rc_j); HHI = sum_i p_i^2.
component_risk.covariance: Inherited L1 60-session EWMA covariance with deterministic PSD clipping.
component_risk.non_evaluable: Missing/nonfinite required input, missing/constant/nonfinite q for N_eff, failed covariance, or zero/nonfinite denominator makes the whole paired week non-evaluable and fail-closed.

realized_hhi_delta.formula: Fixed execution-close weights and actual total-return rows t+1 through t+20 only; sample covariance is PSD-clipped then component risk is recomputed; never feed realized covariance into sizing.

top_dependency_delta.formula: market_share=max_i p_i; macro_sleeve_share=sum p_i in fixed sleeves; top_dependency=max(market_share, macro_sleeve_share); delta=U4-U8.

n_eff_delta.formula: Use continuous signed q for every asset on exactly trailing 52 common eligible weekly decision dates ending at t; every series complete/nonconstant; Pearson correlation, negative-eigenvalue clipping, clipped mass, N_eff=(sum lambda)^2/sum(lambda^2), delta=U8-U4; mean absolute off-diagonal correlation is diagnostic only.

statistics.actual_recalculation: For each metric and each plan separately recompute sample SD, lags 1-5, dependence inflation, HAC/Newey-West interval, falsify MinTRL, validation-zero MinTRL, and validation-minimum-useful MinTRL; no metric may fund another.

best_market.selection: Select the U8 market with greatest cumulative net PnL contribution after exact asset-attributed locked costs over matched dates; ties use inherited ETF order.
best_market.recalculation: Remove that asset from U8 and U4 if present; renormalize remaining component-risk shares without rerunning or reselecting the strategy; recompute mean HHI delta on the same weeks.
best_market.failure: Zero denominator or nonpositive original mean is non-evaluable and fail-closed.

best_trend_episode.episode_rule: Inherited L1 per-asset episode: consecutive weekly nonzero q of one sign, at most one neutral bridge, ending on opposite sign or two neutrals.
best_trend_episode.selection: Select the U8 asset-episode with greatest cumulative net PnL contribution after costs; ties use inherited asset order then earliest start.
best_trend_episode.recalculation: Remove every paired week in that episode from both U4/U8; recompute mean primary HHI delta on remaining common weeks without alternative episode search.
best_trend_episode.minimum_sample: Remaining observations must meet the actual primary HHI MinTRL.

side_effects.turnover_intensity: sum one-way turnover / sum pre-trade gross exposure on identical paired dates
side_effects.cost_intensity: sum all booked locked costs / sum pre-trade gross exposure on identical paired dates
side_effects.relative_increase: (U8-U4)/U4; comparator zero or nonfinite is non-evaluable.
side_effects.cap_cash_scale_down: Use inherited L3 cap/cash/scale-down indicator and frequency on identical paired dates; delta=U8-U4.

equity_synchronization: all four equity q signs same nonzero
regime_matrix.funding: Each inferential bucket independently meets its metric actual MinTRL; no pooling; underfunded is descriptive and blocks E2 scope.

decision_contract.precedence: scope restriction first; then falsification/constraint breach; then candidate; then funded/evaluable middle.
decision_contract.equality: UCB equal useful threshold is not falsification; LCB equal useful threshold is not validation candidate.
decision_contract.scope_restricted: Any mandatory metric, deterministic constraint, or required E1 input non-evaluable, or any mandatory metric below its falsify actual MinTRL.
decision_contract.falsified_E1_only: Only after scope_restricted is false, a mandatory one-sided 95% UCB strictly below useful threshold or an evaluable deterministic constraint breach.
decision_contract.not_falsified_not_validated_E1: Only after the preceding predicates are false; validation remains sealed.
decision_contract.validation_scope_restricted: Any mandatory validation plan, regime, or constraint is non-evaluable or underfunded.
decision_contract.validation_falsified_E1_only: Only after validation_scope_restricted is false, a validation breach or evaluable constraint breach occurs.
decision_contract.validation_candidate: Only after the preceding validation outcomes are false, every mandatory 95% LCB strictly exceeds useful threshold, all constraints pass, and integrity/adversarial review pass.
decision_contract.not_validated_E1: Only after prior validation predicates are false.
